long_biography.plain_text:
Turkish businessman Hasan Cansız helped the boxer Cemal Kamacı enter professional competition. After watching him fight as an amateur, he offered support and asked him to visit with trainer Garbis Zakaryan. Kamacı obtained his professional licence in Austria. Cansız subsequently paid his expenses on trips to the United States and Europe.

His backing also extended to the arrangements governing the boxer’s career. Kamacı had signed a five-year contract with an Austrian manager whose organisation chose his trainer. Cansız paid compensation to release him from that agreement, allowing Zakaryan to work with him again.
